{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric by removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (~internal_test_mask)
]

# Compute total revenue from completed, non-test orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print the exact values used in evidence
print(f"internal_test_count = {internal_test_count}")
print(f"total_revenue = {total_revenue}")

# Return for submission
internal_test_count, total_revenue"}
